title: Aerial Push In
description: An aerial push in starts high and descends or tightens until a single figure reads in the map. It picks one human out of a city, crowd, or terrain from altitude.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: A system is shown first, then a person is found inside it. The audience is not asked to care before they see the grid, the convoy, or the desert that contains the body.
It is the wrong tool when you are already at eye height, and the wrong tool if a crane-down from a rooftop would reach the face. Altitude is the point of origin.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Begin in a true aerial, then descend and/or push while keeping orientation readable. Do not snap-zoom from a still map; translate.
Prompt an aerial push in from high altitude, descending and tightening from map to person.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to pick one human out of a system. Concrete beat: a border desert, then one unmarked police SUV, then a face in a window.
Do not start the move already on a close-up.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: Aerial Pullback is the reverse, person to map. Crane Down starts on an arm, usually from building height, not from thousands of feet.
An Establishing Shot may be the still first frame. Aerial push is the ride from map to someone.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Sicario finds figures inside desert and border infrastructure from the air. Children of Men uses high-to-ground pressure so a person is located inside a collapsing public space.
Use the find, not the politics as wallpaper.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Aerial push in toward [Subject] from high altitude, descending and tightening from map to person, a high view finding a face. For motion: the camera descends and pushes in from a high aerial toward [Subject].

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a Crane Down or a Slow Zoom In on a wide still. The tell is jib height, or optical enlargement with no descent.
The fix: start at altitude, translate down and in, land on a readable person.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Aerial Push In in film?
It is a high camera that descends and/or advances until one person or vehicle becomes readable inside a landscape or city.
Aerial Push In vs Crane Down
Crane down is an arm descent from local height. Aerial push in begins as true aerial, from helicopter or high drone, then finds a human.
When should I use Aerial Push In?
When a system should be visible before a person is chosen. Do not use it if you are already in a street-level master.
How do I prompt Aerial Push In for AI image or video?
Write high aerial start, camera descends and pushes in toward [Subject], from map to person, continuous, no snap zoom.
